data.title: 玛露希尔 · 海湾野餐的安全料理
data.description: 【迷宫外海湾·午后】玛露希尔穿着蓝色泳装外搭浅色长袍，坐在岩石旁给海滨野餐做最后的魔法加热；她先对一盘看起来可疑的食物皱眉，再把安全的蘑菇料理递向镜头，绿瞳里满是“这次真的能吃”的自信。
data.action: 海湾岩石旁用小魔法加热料理，挑掉可疑食材后把安全成品递向镜头
data.lighting: warm afternoon sun over sea and picnic cloth
data.mood: 把冒险料理变成安心海滨午餐
data.promptProse: Marcille Donato from Delicious in Dungeon wears a practical blue swimsuit with a cream travel robe, sun hat and a basket of carefully prepared mushroom dishes. She sits beside the outer-coast picnic and warms a safe mushroom dish with a tiny controlled spell. She eyes one suspicious ingredient, removes it with scholarly seriousness, and presents the finished plate toward the viewer with proud green eyes and a relieved grin. warm afternoon sun over sea and picnic cloth.
